title: The records the board keeps, written only by use-board.py: each task's task.json and each of its comments/<k>.json

task.title: A task as its task.json keeps it; its body is body.md beside it

title.description: what the task does, in a few words

labels.description: the label names, in the order they were added

state.description: open; completed, closed as done; or stopped, closed as not planned

depends.description: the numbers of the tasks it waits on

createdAt.description: when it was filed, in UTC

updatedAt.description: when a write last changed it or added a comment, in UTC

closedAt.description: when it was last closed, in UTC; null while open

comment.title: A comment as its comments/<k>.json keeps it

kind.description: what it does: a BLOCKED question, a REPORTED report, a DECIDED decision, which holds `decision`, or event, which holds none, or a note written before keywords were asked for

line.description: the words of its keyword line after the keyword, the first line of a note

text.description: Markdown a person reads, what follows the line from the newline that ends it; no code reads it for data

author.description: the session that wrote it, `unknown` for one written before authors were kept

created.description: when it was written, in UTC

holders.description: the sessions that hold the task from now on, replacing every earlier value; empty when no one does

asks.description: on a question, that the owner answers it, not the manager

again.description: on a question, the ref of the question it repeats, which it joins and closes with

options.description: on a question, the answers it offers, which a reader numbers from 1 in this order

live_runs.description: how many live sessions the checks run in one worktree may start in all, replacing every earlier value

by.description: who decided: owner, else the deciding session's name

supersedes.description: the ref of the decision it replaces, anywhere in the same root's tree

answers.description: the refs of the questions it settles, on the same task; an event holding it is an old one, which no verb writes now

judge_note.description: on a decision, the cases a judge tries against the task's criteria, which a worker's read leaves out
